Join DynamicsPrint: A Leading Microsoft Preferred Solution for the Printing and Packaging Industry

DynamicsPrint has pioneered a Microsoft-preferred solution that is recognized as a preferred choice for the printing and packaging industry. Grounded in Microsoft 365 FO, our ISV solution covers every aspect, from quoting and production to resource planning and finance. Since our establishment in 1993, we have dedicated ourselves to the printing industry, accumulating invaluable insights and expertise. Fused with cutting-edge Microsoft technology, our knowledge positions us as trusted advisors and technology partners for the world’s leading printing companies.

ERP Consultant – Implementation

International Customers – Growing Industry – Strong Vertical Solution

We are seeking an experienced ERP Consultant with expertise in production planning to join our team. As a pivotal member of our company, you will be responsible for implementing and optimizing ERP systems, focusing specifically on production processes within the print and packaging industry.

In your role as an Implementation Consultant, you will report directly to the Consultant Manager and engage with our exciting customers in the print and packaging industry. Your primary responsibilities will include conducting GAP analysis, system specifications, manage on-site implementation, training super users, and coordinating with stakeholders. Your key responsibilities will involve:

• Conducting GAP analysis and pre-analysis on-site to understand the capabilities of both the standard solution and DynamicsPrint, identifying needs and potential gaps.

• Managing system implementation and onboarding.

• Facilitating user training and ensuring a smooth transition to the new systems for employees.

• Provide continuous support and make ongoing improvements to ERP solutions based on the company’s evolving needs.

• Collaborating with clients and stakeholders in the print and packaging sector to ensure that the solutions meet expectations and deliver tangible value.

• Coordinating with stakeholders (customers and partners).

• Learning and adapting quickly, with the expectation to independently manage projects after initial guidance in collaboration with internal and external project managers and developers.

What We’re Looking For:

Specialist, manager from the print industry or consultant with ERP experience.

You should have a strong background from the printing industry or ERP systems, excelling in functional expertise and communication, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and adapt in dynamic environments. An as individual, you’re characterized by your ability to manage diversity, work independently, and possess adaptability, teamwork, quick learning, and good communication skills. Experience with relevant print software or ERP software such as Microsoft, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar is preferred, especially with a focus on supply chain, production planning and optimization. Your experience may come from roles as pre-press, other specialist functions or middle management in the printing and packaging industry, or an internal or external ERP consultant. Ideally, you have a relevant education within graphical design/production, a degree in economics, IT, or a related field. We offer a competitive salary package and the opportunity to join a team of highly ambitious and talented individuals based in Farum, or in a hybrid/remote setup.

We offer:

• An exciting opportunity to work with leading companies and complex projects within the print and packaging industry.

• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative work culture.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• To be part of a customer centric growth journey.

Learn more about DynamicsPrint at the DynamicsPrint Website

Information

The application and selection process will be done in collaboration with Brinch & Partners. If you would like to know more about this opportunity and the company, please feel free to contact Partner Martin Bo Sørensen by phone +45 27847406.

We look forward to receiving your CV as soon as possible through the “Apply” button below.

Our technical OT/ICS team is expanding, so we're looking for a senior technical consultant to join an ambitious cybersecurity team working with clients across the globe.

What you'll do

You'll join a team of highly skilled engineers and consultants working at the intersection of IT, Operational Technology (OT), automation, and cybersecurity – with protecting and monitoring OT networks at the core of what we do.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Advanced threat detection and engineering: working extensively with industry-leading technology providers to deploy, test, and tune advanced threat monitoring solutions in production environments

• 
Technical implementation: leading the design and implementation of OT network segmentation projects, architecture redesign, secure remote access integration, and asset/configuration analysis

• 
Consultancy and advisory: acting as trusted advisor to clients and colleagues on architecture reviews and OT risk assessments, and translating technical risk into business impact

What you'll bring

We're looking for a seasoned OT Cybersecurity Principal Consultant with extensive experience in infrastructure solutions and technology deployment in OT environments.

The ideal candidate comes with:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, including client-facing consulting roles

• 
Demonstrated capability across critical security domains such as network segmentation, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, secure remote access, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and Security Operations Centre enablement

• 
A track record of continuous technical development — for example, certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC, CCNA/CCNP, or product certifications with recognised OT security vendors such as Nozomi or Claroty

Clearance for SECRET (HEMMELIGT) with Danish authorities is a plus.

What we offer

We're a growing and ambitious tech startup that puts technical excellence first. We invest in the tools, tradecraft, and certifications needed to stay at the forefront of our domains, and continuously sharpen our expertise.

You'll join a team of highly skilled specialists working on complex OT cybersecurity challenges, helping shape both our capabilities and the services we bring to market.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

For any questions about the position, contact Anders Rømer at anrs@thetechcollective.eu.

Company Description

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

• Hands-on experience with ITIL, Lean, structured change management and the agile framework SAFe, which is how our teams work

• The option to use real cases for projects or your thesis

• Flexible hours that fit your studies and exams

• Engaged colleagues, a lunch programme with healthy and varied meals, and Friday bars

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You help us turn improvements into results, and most of that happens in conversation with people. Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Data and insight: Collect and analyse data, build dashboards, and explain what the numbers show and how our initiatives are working.

• Following up on improvement actions: Keep track of our actions, check with the owners that they are delivered, and find out why when something stalls.

• Making larger initiatives easy to join: One example is our CMDB, a map of how applications and servers connect. You create templates, plan the steps with the teams and help remove what blocks them.

• Working with people: Talk to colleagues instead of hiding behind the screen. Join a stand-up, send a Slack message or walk over, and make it easy for people to help.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You do not need experience. We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Is curious about data and what it tells you, with Excel as a good starting point

• Enjoys bringing structure to messy tasks

• Likes talking to people and following up until things get done

• Is motivated to learn, not least how IT runs a large retail business

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme with at least 12 months of studies left

• Communicates fluently in English. Danish is a plus

• Can be at the office in Aarhus at least one day a week

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Manager of IT Operational Excellence, Jan B. Olsen at +45 2779 3597.

We interview on an ongoing basis and remove the ad once we have found the right candidate. You may be asked to work through a short case of about one hour.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click "I'm interested/Apply", you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values - Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit - express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.

Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Machine Learning Researcher at Alipes.

At Alipes, we have been the market leader in automating the financial markets since we started back in 2008, shaping a fully automatic natural language processing system for reading and interpreting financial news.

To accomplish our mission of being the best at what we do, we understand the importance of elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels. Your work will involve leading the efforts in creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to seamlessly turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the financial markets.

In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

• 
Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks

• 
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines

• 
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.

You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no sales people to consult.

About the team

All of this will happen in an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done. We are a tight-knit modeling team with fourteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities – eleven PhD’s and three MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We are working alongside two other teams of software developers and traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. What makes this constellation work great is that all of the individual team members write code and understand that a seemingly trivial change can actually require a lot of work, and vice versa.

About you

• 
Fluency within mathematics and statistics.

• 
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.

• 
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.

• 
Proficiency with computer science fundamentals.

• 
A scientific and inquisitive mind.

Nice to have

• 
Experience working with ‘out-of-core’ datasets.

• 
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.

• 
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.

• 
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.

What we can offer you

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern, harbour front office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and, in lieu of providing a cover letter, concisely answer the questions on the application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

Should you have questions about the role that you would like clarified before applying, you're welcome to send an email to quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please note that applications should not be sent to the email address but rather via the job link.

Due to summer holidays, our response times may be a little longer than usual. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to reviewing your application.

Company Description

Are you motivated by shaping the future of JYSK through architectural direction rather than specific technologies? Can you inspire and coach teams to turn business ambitions into sustainable solutions? Do you thrive in the space between business and technology, translating strategic objectives into architectural guidance and helping others make sound decisions?

The technologies may change, but your passion for creating clear direction, strong collaboration, and sustainable architecture remains constant.

Are you experienced in within the domain of retail solutions and have a strong knowledge of what matters in software architecture within this domain?

Then you could be the one we are looking for!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In JYSK your official title will be Release Train Architect and you will shape the architecture within our retail domain and influence the broader direction across JYSK—all in an informal and collaborative environment.

JYSK has strong ambitions in omnichannel commerce for creating even better customer experiences across all our channels. With over 3,500 stores and more than 100 new openings each year, retail is a core part of our IT landscape.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues.

• A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally.

• A workplace in an exciting international company where results, expansion and development have a high priority.

• A relaxed and open minded atmosphere with rich opportunities to cooperate with colleagues at all levels of the organisation.

• Several social activities during the year, including Friday bars, DHL run, Christmas party etc.

• A healthy work-life balance as well as a strong company culture with a short distance from decision to action.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As part of the leadership team for our Retail Excellence ART consisting of 7 product teams, you will play a key role as the main architect in shaping the architecture that supports JYSK stores and the retail capabilities that enable thousands of colleagues to serve customers every day. You will help guide the evolution of our store systems landscape, ensuring that solutions are sustainable, scalable, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural principles.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, product teams, engineers, and fellow architects to provide architectural direction, facilitate decision-making, and create alignment across the organization. You are not expected to be the technical expert in every solution. Instead, you are a leader, coach, and trusted sparring partner who enables others to make sound architectural decisions and translate business ambitions into valuable outcomes.

Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Architect you will join a team of three Enterprise Architects and five Release Train Architects.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Ensuring technical governance and architectural roadmap within the ART.

• Collaboration and alignment with architects and solution specialists across the organisation.

• Writing solution designs within the domain of our retail and store operations.

• Guiding teams to the right solutions and being a visible sparring partner.

• Being a central sparring partner with external vendor on the POS system, being able to translate between tech and business.

You can read more about our department at https://job.jysk.dk/dk/head-office/it

The current tech stack includes Enactor point of sales system, custom development using the Java and React development stacks, SAP S/4Hana ERP backend. In recent years we have modernised our landscape shifting towards a more headless and event driven architecture.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

In your architect role you understand the importance of stability and performance in the daily work of a store employee. This will require you understand the importance of time to market in the business of retail. Furthermore, you can navigate and cater your dialogue to all levels in the organisation both in business and IT.

You are driven by the architecture discipline itself, understanding how principles, governance, collaboration, and long-term thinking create business value with a focus on translating this into actionable actions.

You enjoy challenging assumptions, facilitating discussions, and influencing decisions that shape the foundation of JYSK's future growth and transformation.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has experience from an architect position and possess good understanding of the architecture domains (business, data, application, technology).

• Are proactive, independent and naturally drives the architectural agenda.

• Takes initiative and achieves results which are aligned with the strategic prioritisation.

• Naturally creates results through others and are hands-on when needed.

• Has a curious and open mindset.

• Can translate business initiatives into architectural roadmap for ART.

• Demonstrates excellent communication skills at all levels.

• Preferrable have experience from retail.

• Naturally feels comfortable in a leadership role

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Senior Enterprise Architect, Michael Nyholm Telling at +45 4012 4218

Are you ready to develop your career in trading and gain insights into the energy markets? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you have impact from day one? At Alipes Capital, we offer the unique opportunity to work with highly skilled, innovative and fun colleagues while utilizing cutting edge technology.

We are seeking our next motivated Energy Analyst to join our growing energy trading desk.

About Alipes

We use machine learning technology for reading and interpreting fundamental and market data and execute our trading strategies based on this data. Since our inception in 2008, we have continuously grown and diversified into new business areas driven by our technology. Alipes aims to support liquid electricity markets and free flow of energy, which are crucial to facilitate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, thereby promoting a sustainable future.

We are centrally located in Nordhavn, Copenhagen, and have 80 bright and ambitious team members.

About the Job

You will be a part of a dynamic team whose primary responsibility is to develop new strategies and ensure that all algorithms and systems run smoothly on a daily basis. This means handling the full algorithm life-cycle from inception, through calibration, backtesting, live-implementation, validation and post-release monitoring and optimisation.

At Alipes, we offer a steep learning curve with responsibility and ownership from day one. You will have the responsibility for reviewing positions and overall exposure, as well as adjusting if applicable - this also includes shared on-call responsibility within the team for the occasional calls that come in outside of business hours. We take pride in maintaining a healthy risk reward trade-off by maximizing revenue under exposure and regulatory constraints. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our Tech and Quant teams.

About You

• 
You have a Masters in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or related field, or a Bachelors with some relevant professional experience.

• 
Experience working with Python. Experience with SQL is a plus.

• 
Experience with energy or trading in financial markets.

• 
Structured, analytical and enjoy analyzing large data sets and working with numbers

• 
Able to thrive and stay calm in a high pressure environment

• 
Conscientious with an eye for detail, even when tasks become routine

• 
You take initiative and ownership in your work.

• 
You don't mind occasionally working outside the standard office hours

What We can Offer You

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn).

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Join Alipes

To apply, please send us your CV as well as a copy of your university transcripts/grades via the application link. You are welcome to contact us with questions at Energy_jobs@alipescapital.com.

Please do not send your application to the email address as our hiring team will not have visibility. We look forward to hearing from you!

Company Description

At Coach Solutions, we build software that helps the global shipping industry work smarter and make data-driven decisions — for both profit and sustainability. Backed by Kongsberg Maritime, we're entering a new phase: modernizing our architecture and scaling our impact.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer to join our Platform & Development department. You'll take ownership of frontend development across our SaaS products, working closely with developers, QA, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable software used by customers across the shipping industry.

Our stack centres on Next.js, React, Typescript and Vercel, backed by Azure and .NET Standard services, with Mapbox and tilesets powering our geospatial visualizations. We're an AI-fluent team — you'll be expected to use AI-assisted tools as part of how you work, not just be curious about them.

Qualifications

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain modern frontend applications with React and Next.js.

• Build interactive maps and geospatial visualizations using Mapbox and tilesets.

• Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs, including .NET Standard services — with room to grow into full-stack work overtime.

• Contribute to modernizing our existing architecture, with an eye on maintainability, scalability, and security.

• Own features end-to-end: from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and monitoring (via tools like Monitive).

• Use GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control, code review, and CI/CD.

• Use AI-assisted development tools day-to-day to improve code quality, testing, and delivery speed.

• Share knowledge, raise technical risks early, and help shape how the team works.

What you bring

Must have

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and production software used by real customers.

• Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Solid grasp of frontend architecture: component design, state management, responsive UIs.

• Experience integrating frontend apps with REST APIs and backend services.

• Comfortable with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Genuinely AI-fluent: you already use AI coding tools and understand their limits, not just open to trying them.

• Clear communicator — able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have (we'll teach the rest)

• Experience with Mapbox, tilesets, or geospatial data — no prior background required if you're keen to learn.

• Exposure to Vercel deployment workflows.

• Comfort working in Azure-based environments.

• .NET Standard experience, or interest in growing into full-stack work.

• Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools such as Monitive.

Additional Information

Practical details

• Location: Copenhagen, on-site with hybrid flexibility

• Team: Platform & Development department

Why Coach Solutions

• A purpose-driven workplace at the intersection of tech and sustainability.

• Real influence: if you see the problem, you own it — and if you make the best argument, you win, regardless of title.

• An informal, social culture — monthly Friday bars, team events, summer and winter parties, family events, and more.

• A skilled mentor and an experienced, engineering-minded team eager to help you succeed.

• Room to grow — new responsibilities and career paths as the company scales.

Don't check every box?

That's okay — we'd still love to hear from you. If you have strong frontend experience, a passion for building great software, and the motivation to learn and grow, reach out. Let's build something meaningful together.

Own information security governance, risk and compliance at a growing Danish fintech. As our Information Security & Compliance Manager, you’ll lead audit and assurance work, turn security requirements into controls that teams can use in their day-to-day work, and help management decide which risks and improvements to prioritise.

About Loyalty Key

Loyalty Key is a fast-growing Danish fintech company that develops and operates digital loyalty solutions. Our own card-linked technology makes it possible to earn cashback with any payment card.

Through Visa Cashback and Danske Bank Cashback, we connect more than 500,000 members with over 2,000 partner retailers.

We also operate significant parts of the SAS EuroBonus programme, including its Nordic online shopping platform, where members earn points when they shop online.

About the role

You’ll take ownership of our information security and compliance framework, maintain our existing assurance programme and help prepare the business for future certifications. You’ll work closely with management, IT and teams across the business. You’ll lead governance, risk and compliance, while our IT team will be responsible for implementing technical security measures.In this role, you’ll:

• 
Maintain and develop our security and compliance framework, including policies, procedures and controls.

• 
Coordinate audits and assurance activities, organise evidence and follow up on findings until they’re resolved.

• 
Carry out risk assessments, monitor how well controls work and report key risks and priorities to management.

• 
Work with IT and other teams to put security requirements into practice and make responsibilities clear.

• 
Support supplier security assessments and respond to customer requests about security and compliance.

What you bring

You have experience in information security, compliance, IT risk or audit, and you’ve worked with security controls, audits or assurance frameworks. You understand the technology behind the controls and can explain what a requirement means in practice to technical and non-technical colleagues.

You’re organised, pragmatic and comfortable working independently. You document decisions clearly, take initiative and follow through on agreed actions.

Experience with ISAE 3402, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar standards and frameworks is an advantage, as is experience in fintech, payments, SaaS or financial services. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. You must have the right to live and work in Denmark.

Why work at Loyalty Key

• 
Join a team of 45 with an informal culture, short decision-making paths and room to take ownership.

• 
Shape how we manage information security, risk and compliance as the company grows, with direct access to management and close collaboration across teams.

• 
Develop professionally and personally through a varied role with broad responsibility.

• 
Receive a salary based on your qualifications, health insurance and other employee benefits.

• 
Get to know your colleagues through social events, Friday bars and shared celebrations.

Start date and location

The start date is by agreement. Our Copenhagen office is at Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, between Østerport and Nordhavn stations.

Questions and applications

For more information about the role, contact Aaron Morley at aam@loyaltykey.com.**

We are seeking a GRC Analyst to manage our daily risk and control operations, maintain our documentation library and support audit coordination within our Trust Office. In this role, you'll help build and be part of our governance operating model as we scale our compliance and security efforts.

You’ll work closely with the GRC Officer, CTO and partner heavily with the Product Team.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Control Testing & Risk Tracking: Execute routine security control testing and maintain Key Risk Indicators.

• 
Trust Center Maintenance: Keep our public security trust center and standard security documentation up-to-date so existing and potential customers can self-service security reviews.

• 
Customer Compliance: Assist with routine incoming customer inquiries, security questionnaires and vendor assessments.

• 
Audit and Policy Support: Assist with external audit readiness (state certifications such as MitID Broker, NSIS, FTN and our ISMS ISAE 3000) and perform regular policy reviews.

• 
Vendor Risk Management: Evaluate third-party vendors and cloud subprocessors to ensure they meet our security standards before onboarding.

• 
Vulnerability Triage: Serve as the first point of contact for vulnerability disclosures, assessing severity and coordinating remediation with engineering.

Requirements

• 
3+ years of experience in governance of risk and compliance, IT audit, or risk management.

• 
Solid understanding of core security controls and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, risk methodologies).

• 
Ability to translate technical vulnerability data into actionable risk assessments.

• 
Ability to balance security requirements with business agility, finding solutions that work with engineering workflows rather than blocking them.

• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• 
It’s a plus if you are familiar with hyperscalers and cloud platforms, in a SaaS setup like MS Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.

• 
Experience with process automation and configuring AI agents is a plus.

For more information or questions please contact us at security@idura.eu

Working at

Idura

Idura is a Copenhagen-based company specializing in secure user authentication and digital signature solutions using electronic identities (eIDs). We empower companies to integrate eIDs into websites or applications effortlessly, ensuring an efficient, secure login or signature process at a cost-effective price. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we offer MitID as well as a range of European eIDs, including BankID in Sweden and Norway, Finnish Trust Network (FTN) and itsme in Belgium. Our mission is to ensure the highest level of security in digital verification, making the digital world a safer place to roam. Authentication We provide a fast and simple integration of eIDs for businesses that want to verify their customers on their website or app. Our solution allows your users to authenticate themselves with secure and KYC compliant eIDs, which provides the most secure and user-friendly login experience possible. Digital signatures Implement digital signatures into your workflow and sign PDF documents digitally with eIDs. We ensure that all of our digital signatures are secure and compliant with PAdES and eIDAS.

Senior Finance Business Partner, Commercial Performance Europe

Location: Gentofte, Denmark or Lisbon, Portugal

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

Are you passionate about turning commercial performance into strategic business value? Do you want to influence key decisions, drive profitability, and help shape the future of a leading international business? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Senior Finance Business Partner, Commercial Performance Europe, you will be part of the Group Finance organization and play an important role in driving commercial performance across Europe. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Category Management, Operations, and Finance leaders to translate commercial strategy into measurable financial outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to influence strategic decisions, support the delivery of our Focus2030 ambitions, and strengthen value creation across multiple European markets.

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

Incentives and Benefits:** The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

Our recruitment process

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:

proprty.ai is building a service to help Danish property managers leverage machine learning technology to create better condition assessments and maintenance plans. The cost of maintaining the Danish property mass is growing fast, and property managers are struggling to keep up with maintenance and regulatory responsibilities. This is not only hurting the property managers, but also the people using and living in the buildings. The challenge to live up to the EU Taxonomy for Sustainable Activities, is made harder, by not having the tools nor data to make the right strategic choices when planning and executing maintenance. With our service we aim to create property condition assessment and maintenance plans faster and more accurately than what is possible today. Using machine learning algorithms trained on millions of m2 worth of data, we can provide property managers with data to make the right decisions, when it comes to spending resources on maintenance. That way they can cut costs, improve property conditions and push the property mass towards a sustainable future. We're creating an AI powered web platform, that allows property managers to create condition assessments and maintenance plans in a fraction of the time they're using today, by mixing output from our machine learning models with boots on the ground input. It's not only faster. It provides high quality data instead of subjective information. At proprty.ai we've already signed partnerships with 18% of the Danish residential property market. We have a very real problem to solve, and a strong team to do it.

Picture your typical week: on Monday you’re on-site at a pharmaceutical client, leading a cross-functional team through a critical MES go-live. By Wednesday you’re working with the IT leadership to turn your delivery results into a business case for the next phase. Friday, you’re back at Emendo’s Nordhavn office sharing what you learned and sharpening the methods your colleagues will use on their projects. If that sounds like work you’d love, keep reading.

Why We’re Hiring Now

We paused hiring over the past year to be deliberate about the team we build next. The consulting market in Denmark has tightened, and our clients have changed how they buy: they want fewer consultants with more experience, people who can walk into a complex situation and show measurable progress within weeks, not months. We are now making a small number of senior hires — each one matters, and we are taking the time to find the right people.

About Emendo

Emendo is a 200-person consultancy built by people who used to sit on the client side — running transformation programmes inside pharma before deciding to do it for a living. We understand the pressure a site director feels before a go-live, we know what an inspector looks for, and we speak the language of the people who operate the systems we implement. We work across the full pharmaceutical value chain from R&D through shipping, with offices in Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Odense, Silkeborg, Munich, and Raleigh (USA). Our strategy is simple: deliver faster, prove value in hard numbers, and use our methods and AI tools to do what we do well — only quicker.

We are a methods-driven firm rooted in operational excellence and Lean. Our motto, Observe, Think, Improve, is itself a method: go to the floor, understand what is actually happening, analyse it rigorously, then design and implement a concrete improvement. That simplicity is what makes it reliable when the project gets complicated and the usual playbooks stop working.

The Role

You will lead IT/OT transformation engagements for clients in pharma and regulated industries — operating at the intersection of technology, business process, and organisational change. You are expected to create measurable impact from the outset, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Emendo’s footprint within your accounts. At Emendo, seniority means more than years served: it means sound judgement in ambiguity, credibility with demanding stakeholders, and the willingness to raise the standard of the whole team.

What You Will Do

• Lead client engagements on-site, owning delivery of IT/OT implementations across enterprise, operations management, process control, and process equipment layers

• Drive measurable progress in short cycles — the kind your client’s leadership can point to in a steering committee: cost reduced, lead time shortened, risk closed out

• Manage project governance, solution architecture alignment, and validation concepts within complex, multi-stakeholder environments

• Shape how Emendo works — contribute to our methods, package what you learn into repeatable offerings and case studies, and use AI tools to deliver faster without cutting corners

• Build lasting client relationships — become a trusted partner to your stakeholders, spot opportunities for follow-on work, and contribute to Emendo’s business development by turning strong delivery into new engagements

• Apply Observe, Think, Improve as your foundation — and mentor junior colleagues to do the same

What It Takes

Must-Have Qualifications

• Master’s degree in engineering, IT, or a related discipline

• 6–10+ years of hands-on delivery experience in IT/OT project management, product ownership, or solution implementation — ideally within pharma or other regulated industries, though strong candidates from adjacent sectors are welcome

• Track record of delivering quantifiable business outcomes (cost reduction, lead-time improvement, risk mitigation) — not just on-time/on-budget projects

• Strong command of project governance, stakeholder management, and the ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior client leadership

• Deep understanding of at least one area: enterprise systems (ERP/MES), process control, IT–OT convergence, or value chain technology

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Danish skills are strongly preferred, or a commitment to learn

• Willingness to work on-site at client locations in Denmark and occasionally internationally

Nice to have — but not required

None of the following are dealbreakers. If you tick even one or two, it tells us you will ramp up faster — but we have seen great consultants arrive without any of them and build the expertise here.

• Experience with GxP compliance, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), or regulatory frameworks in life sciences

• Familiarity with AI/automation tools applied to enterprise transformation or operational settings

• Background in operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies

• Experience working across multiple sites or geographies in global transformation programmes

• Comfort with outcome-based or fixed-price engagement models

What Makes Emendo Different

• Measured on outcomes, not utilisation — you work directly with industry leaders on engagements that matter

• One integrated firm with deep methods: cross-unit collaboration across Implementation, Engineering, Digital, and R&D, backed by a Lean toolbox and AI accelerators

• Freedom under responsibility — challenging projects with room to shape the solution and your own career

• A flat culture where your input matters and your wins are celebrated

• Competitive compensation reflecting the seniority and impact expected in this role

This role is probably not for you if:

• You prefer purely advisory work with limited implementation responsibility.

• You work best with narrow ownership and very clear boundaries.

• You have strong technical exposure but limited experience leading cross-functional change.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We are hiring two to three Senior Consultants this year. Each one joins a team that has led some of the largest IT/OT programmes in US and European pharma — people who chose Emendo because they wanted senior-level impact in a firm that still feels personal. If that resonates, we’d like to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We will be in touch promptly.

For further information, reach out to Mikael Elley (me@emendo.com or +45 24 83 62 01).

Would you like to help build and develop the platform that makes it easier for Whiteaway’s software Engineers to develop, deploy and run their solutions?

Whiteaway Group is looking for a skilled Platform Engineer to join their Platform Squad in Aarhus.

As a Platform Engineer, you will become part of a strong technical environment focused on building and continuously improving the platform used by Whiteaway’s development teams in their daily work.

This is not traditional IT operations. Instead, the focus is on creating automated, stable and scalable solutions that make it easier for Engineers to develop, deploy and run their software.

Whiteaway is a digital-first company where technology plays a central role in the business. The company operates some of the largest online stores in the Nordics within electronics and home appliances, and its technical platforms are an important part of the continued development of the business.

Your role

You will play a central role in developing and improving Whiteaway’sinternal platform and will work closely with software Engineers and the other members of the Platform Squad.

A key part of the role is the close collaboration with Engineers. You will be curious about how they work, understand their needs and challenges, and use their feedback to identify how workflows, processes and platform tooling can be made simpler, faster and better.

Over the coming years, Whiteaway will be taking the platform to a significantly higher level. A key focus will be reducing and removing legacy and building a more modern, scalable and developer-friendly platform. AI will also play an increasingly important role in how the platform develops and how Whiteaway’s Engineers work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and continuously improving the cloud platform

• Automating deployment and development processes

• Infrastructure as Code

• CI/CD pipelines

• Containerisation and Kubernetes

• Cloud infrastructure – primarily AWS

• Monitoring, observability and reliability

• Engineering tooling and self-service solutions

• Security and access management

• Troubleshooting and optimising platform performance and stability

The role offers a high degree of freedom, and you will have the opportunity to take ownership and influence both the technology and the way the team works.

Whiteaway believes in freedom under responsibility. You will have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions and help shape both the platform and the way the team works.

We imagine that you…

You have a strong technical background and experience within software development, cloud, DevOps or platform engineering. Perhaps you are already working as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer or Senior Software Engineer with strong cloud and infrastructure experience.

Your title is less important than your motivation to work hands-on with platform engineering and your ability to thrive at the intersection of software development, cloud and operations. Experience with general software development is an advantage, particularly Node.js and/or Go.

We would like you to have experience with several of the following technologies and tools:

• AWS

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• Terraform / Infrastructure as Code

• CI/CD

• Git/GitHub

• Linux

• Node.js and/or Go

• Datadog

• ArgoCD

• Spacelift

• Cloudflare

• Monitoring and observability

• Networking and cloud infrastructure

Experience with GitOps is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience with security or with the intersection between operations and software development is also considered an advantage.

You do not need to know everything. What matters most is that you have strong technical curiosity, can understand complex problems and are motivated to continuously improve the way things are done.

Your professional development is important to Whiteaway.

You will have the opportunity to work with development plans, strengthen your technical skills and take your expertise to the next level. At the same time, knowledge sharing is an important part of the culture – you are expected not only to develop yourself, but also to help lift others around you.

On a personal level, drive, determination and humility are highly valued. You take ownership and get things done, while remaining curious, collaborative and motivated to find the best solutions together with others.

What Whiteaway offers

At Whiteaway, you will be part of an informal, inclusive and supportive leadership culture where Engineers have real ownership and the opportunity to influence their work. The culture is built around experimentation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning, with opportunities to take part in hackathons, pair programming and MOB programming, as well as access to learning resources.

The social side of working together is also important. People at Whiteaway genuinely enjoy working together, and there is a strong focus on building good relationships across the team. Through activities such as hackathons, Improvement Mondays and other social initiatives, there are plenty of opportunities to come together, share knowledge, experiment and have fun.

Whiteaway also values a healthy work-life balance, a great lunch and good colleagues. The office is located in Skejby, with free parking.

About Whiteaway Group

Whiteaway Group is a tribe of 300+ passionate people working across Scandinavia, selling and shipping appliances through e-commerce, franchise stores and B2B channels.

Around 250 employees are based at the headquarters in Aarhus, covering the group’s central functions. Around 45 people work within Tech across IT, Engineering and Product. The Platform Squad currently consists of four Platform Engineers, and the team is expected to grow in the coming years as the demands on and use of the platform continue to increase – including with the growing use of AI.

With brands like Skousen, Tretti and Whiteaway, the group is grounded in innovation and honesty, always pushing for better customer experiences through technology.

Interested in joining Whiteaway Group?

Bloom is handling the recruitment process on behalf of Whiteaway Group and is actively reviewing applications. We look forward to receiving your application and CV in Danish or English as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact IT Recruitment Manager Dorte Pape at Bloom at dp@bloom.dk or on +45 3160 9365.

About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

• 
Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• 
Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• 
Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• 
Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• 
Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.
